title: Claude runtime adapter
description: Objective: implement the Foundation Claude capability probe and runtime adapter contract. Deliverable: focused runner provider modules plus development-only golden streams for complete, crash, truncate, reorder, cancel, and version-change cases. NOT in scope: Codex, billing assumptions, automatic authority, or provider resume unless capability-proven. Hard dependency: Runtime contract registry. Owned paths: packages/runner/src/providers/claude/** and packages/testkit/src/providers/claude/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test.
definitionOfDone: Probe records an immutable runtime closure and returns typed UNSUPPORTED for every unproven capability.
Structured and raw events preserve exact order/bytes and bind the stable Moe effect identity.
Cancellation, crash, truncation, reordering, and runtime drift reconcile to proven result or honest UNKNOWN.
The focused runner typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Follow the pinned design; this task cannot create authority beyond its named contract.
Fail closed with stable codes and immutable deterministic outputs.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400.
Use TDD and stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.
